# North Star capability matrix

Authority: `CODEX_MASTER_SPEC_VIDEO_FACTORY_V2.md`, sections 0–89, plus VF-NORTH-STAR-COMPLETION-PROGRAM-01.

Audit baseline: `2ced7bc81f9402368fb22c9e7aca242e740531af`. This matrix describes inspected source and its remaining behavior. IMPLEMENTED_REAL means executable non-fixture behavior exists; it does not certify real-provider acceptance or production deployment. Historical acceptance is preserved separately. Source hashes are in `docs/north-star/source-inventory.json`.

The Native Studio and PostgreSQL Studio are separate implementations. Their existing analysis, media, publishing and analytics paths are not automatically available in the accepted Native workflow. This integration gap is P0. No phase report alone proves a requirement.

[scripts/north_star_native_narrated_music.py](../scripts/north_star_native_narrated_music.py), [docs/NATIVE_NARRATED_MUSIC_LOOPS.md](../docs/NATIVE_NARRATED_MUSIC_LOOPS.md), [docs/north-star/native-narrated-music-evidence.json](../docs/north-star/native-narrated-music-evidence.json). Real Native FFmpeg and API Remotion/FFmpeg render paths. New Native project quality policy v1 normalizes the three required names visibly before review, rejects unreviewed spellings, checks measured narration tails/gaps, hard-validates profile canvas, and detects actual decoded PCM trailing silence. Legacy project versions remain unchanged. API Remotion locally encodes all four aspect ratios with source-relative crop keyframes; 4:5 review is 432x540 to avoid odd YUV420 dimensions, final is 1080x1350. Actual FFprobe geometry and decoded crop traversal have synthetic-media evidence. Private Native renderer transport stages selected media only, validates the versioned contract, exposes exact media routes behind an ephemeral loopback token, supports Range playback and closes on success/failure. It rejects external paths, metadata files and junction escapes; prior outputs cannot be replaced. A Native-specific limited-range YUV420p/BT.709/48kHz profile is actually encoded with Unicode captions and original timeline audio. v2.3 supports VI/EN, up to 600s and explicitly absent captions; historical v2.0â€“2.2 constraints remain. Native source jobs now use the same canonical snapshot, stage selected media privately, encode original audio and Unicode captions without narration/provider dispatch, register checksum-bound artifacts and reuse only verified final checkpoints. An actual worker render on synthetic media passes measured full QC and preserves source/project bytes. Actual linked trim/split plus versioned karaoke Source settings pass the real local worker/encoder/full-QC path in a separate synthetic fixture; the canonical document and source assets remain unchanged by encoding. Native Source music intake now projects immutable rights-attested audio into the same canonical timeline, repeats bounded clips without stretching, adds editable gain/fades and preserves prior music metadata for exact snapshot restore. Active music hash/rights/path checks apply to proxy, approval and final render. A separate synthetic linked-source/music/karaoke worker passes real local full QC without changing source bytes or creating final human review. Versioned Native Source processing defaults off and opts into original/music loudnorm before saved clip gain plus actual original-energy sidechain ducking. Preview and final render reuse the same pure role-aware graph; muted/disabled roles do not claim ducking. Settings reject affected locked audio tracks, changed settings invalidate preview/approval, short windows explicitly skip normalization, and receipts keep unavailable integrated loudness null without claiming speech detection. Real PCM tests verify exact sample duration, preserved gain/source signal, music reduction only during source activity and limiter bounds; a separate actual synthetic Source worker/DSP bundle passes full QC. Native Source now reuses the pure supporting-media planner/placement over the existing SQLite project history and canonical timeline. Saved plans are checksum-bound, immutable and deduplicated; creating/selecting a plan leaves the timeline unchanged. Explicit selection/application binds project/timeline/plan versions, saved transcript, original source and selected asset hashes. Placement maps through linked trim/split/reorder/speed, supports bounded video and image clips, preserves source audio/captions and rejects locked/overlapping placements unless explicit replacement is requested. Unknown rights reject application; owner upload attestation is precisely attributed, not independent license verification. Studio exposes plans, heuristic intent/query/confidence, uploaded candidates/provenance and explicit select/apply/replace controls. Stock/AI/semantic Vision remain NOT_CONFIGURED on this bridge and dispatch zero providers. A separate synthetic source/B-roll/music/DSP/karaoke worker passes real local full QC; intentional still intervals explain static imagery, and final review remains unapproved. Native Source duplication now validates active immutable media and all saved analysis/plan records, derives new project/analysis/transcript/segment/word/scene/plan/evidence identities and fingerprints, retains exact media/timing/audio/crop decisions and resets canonical history to version 1. Explicit lineage preserves original record/transcript/plan hashes and identifies evidence reuse rather than a fresh provider measurement. Historical stale analysis stays stale; no provider is dispatched. The duplicate is unapproved, has no inherited jobs/preview/final review, supports independent edits/B-roll replacement and leaves parent/history/media unchanged. A separate real local synthetic duplicate proxy/worker/full-QC bundle produces identical final media bytes while identity-bound manifests differ. Native Auto Shorts reuses the unchanged shared complete-speech highlight builder after extracting it from API persistence dependencies. Exact selected transcript and saved fused scene evidence score up to five candidates; whole words/segments remain protected, over-limit windows are skipped and identical windows deduplicate. Top 3/Top 5 create only the available count as independent unapproved Source projects in one transaction, with parent/document/evidence lineage and checksum-bound media reuse. Durable request-key/body hashing makes retries return existing drafts and rejects changed requests; a simulated second-child failure rolls back the entire batch. Parent timeline/approval/history are unchanged. Authenticated HTTP exposes creation and saved batch history; Native Assets controls create drafts and open each canonical shot/timeline separately. No B-roll/music/manual edits are inherited silently, and each draft requires new preview/human review. Four canvases are supported; missing subject tracking is marked center_crop/needs_attention with confidence null. A separate actual synthetic one-candidate batch honestly returns 1/3 and passes local vertical preview/worker/full QC without any provider/TTS call or final self-acceptance. Native Source now offers a versioned final-effects preview using the same private Remotion composition, subtitle/crop/transition props and canonical processed audio as final rendering, scaled to 40 percent resolution. Profile-scoped cache, hashes, approval/revision binding, cancellation and decode/probe checks preserve historical lightweight proxies. Local synthetic preview/final evidence verifies equal rendering props apart from independent cue IDs and identical PCM mix bytes, with Vietnamese karaoke visibly within bounds. New Native project quality policy v1 normalizes the three required names visibly before review, rejects unreviewed spellings, checks measured narration tails/gaps, hard-validates profile canvas, and detects actual decoded PCM trailing silence. Legacy project versions remain unchanged. Native source workers reuse full measured geometry/fps/codecs/audio/A-V/black/freeze/decode/subtitle/timeline and pixel-sampled QC, plus decoded PCM trailing-activity checks. Hard failure persists attempt evidence and uses failed_qc/FAILED_QC with no ready final checkpoint. Explicit canonical track muting permits intentional silence while retaining all visual/codec checks; silent nonfinite measurements serialize as null. Cancellation kills/drains owned QC tools. Versioned Native Source processing defaults off and opts into original/music loudnorm before saved clip gain plus actual original-energy sidechain ducking. Preview and final render reuse the same pure role-aware graph; muted/disabled roles do not claim ducking. Settings reject affected locked audio tracks, changed settings invalidate preview/approval, short windows explicitly skip normalization, and receipts keep unavailable integrated loudness null without claiming speech detection. Video features, recommendation-only insights and trend feedback persist. Edit features now use the published render frozen timeline/subtitle/audio versions after a later canonical edit.
